findings.body:
**XSS: unsanitized `body` is injected as HTML.** Removing `escapeHtml` and passing `body` directly into `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` means any comment author (or API that supplies `body`) can run arbitrary script in readers’ sessions — e.g. `` or ``. Failure mode: malicious or compromised comment content executes in the app origin with the victim’s cookies/session. Fix: do not assign untrusted strings to `__html`. Either (1) render plain text / React children, (2) parse a limited markdown subset into React elements, or (3) sanitize with a strict allowlist library before `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. Restore escaping until one of those is in place: ```suggestion return
{body}
; ```
